name: AWS API
description: Amazon Web Services APIs on *.amazonaws.com — STS, S3, EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and more. Every request is signed with AWS Signature Version 4 from the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY secrets (plus AWS_SESSION_TOKEN for temporary credentials); don't send Authorization or X-Amz-Date yourself. The signing service and region come from the hostname, so pick a region by calling its endpoint, e.g. https://dynamodb.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/. Global endpoints such as https://sts.amazonaws.com/ and https://iam.amazonaws.com/ sign for us-east-1.
